note: Release dates and chart peaks are taken from Wikipedia song pages ({{single chart}} templates, and a few verified facts cited on those pages). Fields are omitted when not verified. Billboard Hot 100 numbers use only the exact Billboardhot100 template, not Japan/Global/year-end charts. Later catalog or revival chart rows (date more than 3 years after the original release, or Canadian Hot 100 before that chart launched in 2007) are omitted. Do not invent missing peaks or dates.

vibe.title: Fields of Gold
vibe.about: "Fields of Gold" is a song written and performed by the English musician Sting. It first appeared on his fourth studio album, Ten Summoner's Tales (1993).

vibe.title: Wonderwall
vibe.about: "Wonderwall" is a song by English rock band Oasis, released by Creation Records on 30 October 1995 as the fourth single from the band's second studio album (What's the Story) Morning Glory?. vibe.title: Fast Car
vibe.about: "Fast Car" is a song by American singer-songwriter Tracy Chapman, released as her debut single on April 6, 1988, by Elektra Records. It served as the lead single from her 1988 self-titled debut studio album.

vibe.title: Someone Like You
vibe.about: "Someone like You" is a song recorded by English singer-songwriter Adele. She and Dan Wilson wrote and produced the track for her second studio album, 21 (2011).

vibe.title: Easy on Me
vibe.about: "Easy on Me" is a song by the English singer Adele from her fourth studio album, 30 (2021). Adele wrote the song with its producer, Greg Kurstin.

vibe.title: All of Me
vibe.about: "All of Me" is a song by American singer John Legend from his fourth studio album Love in the Future (2013). It is dedicated to Legend's wife Chrissy Teigen.

vibe.title: Stay with Me
vibe.about: "Stay with Me" is a song by the English singer Sam Smith from their debut studio album In the Lonely Hour (2014). It was released in the United States on 14 April 2014 and in the United Kingdom on 18 May 2014.

vibe.title: I'm Yours
vibe.about: "I'm Yours" is a song written and recorded by American singer-songwriter Jason Mraz, released in 2008 as the first single from his third studio album We Sing. We Dance.

vibe.title: Thinking Out Loud
vibe.about: "Thinking Out Loud" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran recorded for his second studio album, × (2014). It was written by Sheeran and Amy Wadge, and produced by frequent collaborator Jake Gosling.

vibe.title: Perfect
vibe.about: "Perfect" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran from his third studio album, ÷ (2017). After the album's release, it charted at number four on the UK Singles Chart.

vibe.title: Photograph
vibe.about: "Photograph" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran from his second studio album, × (2014). Sheeran wrote the song with Snow Patrol member Johnny McDaid, who had a piano loop from which the composition developed.

vibe.title: Let Her Go
vibe.about: "Let Her Go" is a song recorded by English singer-songwriter Passenger. It was recorded at Sydney's Linear Recording and co-produced by Passenger and Chris Vallejo.

vibe.title: The Scientist
vibe.about: "The Scientist" is a song by British rock band Coldplay. The song is credited to all the band members on their second album, A Rush of Blood to the Head.

vibe.title: Yellow
vibe.about: "Yellow" is a song by the British rock band Coldplay from their debut studio album, Parachutes (2000). The song was written by band members Chris Martin, Jonny Buckland, Guy Berryman, and Will Champion, and co-produced it with British record producer Ken Nelson.

vibe.title: Halo
vibe.about: "Halo" is a song recorded by American singer Beyoncé for her third studio album, I Am... Sasha Fierce (2008).

vibe.title: If I Ain't Got You
vibe.about: "If I Ain't Got You" is a song recorded by American singer-songwriter Alicia Keys for her second studio album, The Diary of Alicia Keys (2003). It was written and produced by Keys.

vibe.title: No One
vibe.about: "No One" is a song recorded by American singer-songwriter Alicia Keys for her third studio album As I Am (2007). It was written and produced by Keys and Kerry Brothers Jr., with additional writing by DJ Dirty Harry.

vibe.title: Dreams
vibe.about: "Dreams" is a song by the British-American rock band Fleetwood Mac, written and sung by Stevie Nicks for the band's eleventh studio album, Rumours (1977). vibe.title: Iris
vibe.about: "Iris" is a song by the American alternative rock band Goo Goo Dolls. Written for the soundtrack of the 1998 film City of Angels, it was included on the sixth Goo Goo Dolls album, Dizzy Up the Girl, and released as the album's lead single on April 1, 1998.

vibe.title: Drops of Jupiter (Tell Me)
vibe.about: "Drops of Jupiter", initially released and sometimes still listed as "Drops of Jupiter (Tell Me)", is a song written and recorded by American rock band Train. The power ballad was released on January 29, 2001, as the lead single from their second studio album, Drops of Jupiter (2001).

vibe.title: Put Your Records On
vibe.about: "Put Your Records On" is a song by the English singer Corinne Bailey Rae from her self-titled debut studio album (2006). Written by Bailey Rae, John Beck, and Steve Chrisanthou, it was released as the album's second single in February 2006; in North America, it served as the album's lead single.

vibe.title: Better Together
vibe.about: "Better Together" is a song written and performed by American singer-songwriter Jack Johnson. The first track on Johnson's third studio album, In Between Dreams (2005), it was released as a single in February 2006.

vibe.title: A Thousand Years
vibe.about: "A Thousand Years" is a ballad recorded by American singer and songwriter Christina Perri, written by Perri and her producer David Hodges, for The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 1. The song was released worldwide as a digital download on October 18, 2011 and serves as the second single by Atlantic Records from…

vibe.title: When I Was Your Man
vibe.about: "When I Was Your Man" is a song by American singer and songwriter Bruno Mars from his second studio album, Unorthodox Jukebox (2012). Atlantic Records released the song as the third promotional single and as the second official single, taken from the album, to mainstream radio in the United States on January 15, 2013.

vibe.title: lovely
vibe.about: "Lovely" is a song by American singers Billie Eilish and Khalid. Darkroom and Interscope Records released it as the lead single from the Netflix drama series 13 Reasons Why's second season soundtrack.

vibe.title: cardigan
vibe.about: "Cardigan" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift and the lead single from her eighth studio album, Folklore (2020). Republic Records released the song on July 24, 2020.

vibe.title: Say You Won't Let Go
vibe.about: "Say You Won't Let Go" is a song by English singer and songwriter James Arthur. The song was released as a digital download on 9 September 2016 in the United Kingdom by Columbia Records as the lead single from his second studio album Back from the Edge (2016).

vibe.title: Bubbly
vibe.about: "Bubbly" is the debut single of American singer-songwriter Colbie Caillat from her first album, Coco (2007). Written by Caillat and Jason Reeves and produced by Mikal Blue, the song was released as the album's lead single on May 15, 2007.

vibe.title: ocean eyes
vibe.about: "Ocean Eyes" is the debut single by American singer-songwriter Billie Eilish. It was initially released on SoundCloud on November 18, 2015, and then temporarily released as a promotional recording on January 8, 2016, with Drup Music.

mood.title: bad guy
mood.about: "Bad Guy" is a song by American singer-songwriter Billie Eilish and the fifth single from her debut studio album, When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go? (2019).
mood.fact: Spent 1 week at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 (chart dated August 24, 2019), ending Lil Nas X’s 19-week run with “Old Town Road.” At 17, Eilish was the first artist born in the 2000s to top the Hot 100.

mood.title: Someday
mood.about: "Someday" is a song by American rock band Sugar Ray. First serviced to American radio in June 1999, the song was released on September 7, 1999, as the second US single and third single overall from the band's third album, 14:59 (1999).

mood.title: Happy
mood.about: "Happy" is a song written, produced, and performed by American musician Pharrell Williams, released as the only single from the soundtrack album for the film Despicable Me 2 (2013). mood.title: Uptown Funk
mood.about: "Uptown Funk" is a song by British-American DJ and record producer Mark Ronson featuring American singer Bruno Mars. It was released on 10 November 2014, as the lead single from Ronson's fourth studio album, Uptown Special (2015).

mood.title: Flowers
mood.about: "Flowers" is a song by American singer Miley Cyrus from her eighth studio album Endless Summer Vacation (2023). Columbia Records released it as the album's lead single on January 12, 2023, in some countries and on January 13 worldwide.

mood.title: Shake It Off
mood.about: "Shake It Off" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift and the lead single from her fifth studio album, 1989 (2014). She wrote the lyrics by herself and composed the melody with the song's producers, Max Martin and Shellback.

mood.title: Blinding Lights
mood.about: "Blinding Lights" is a song by Canadian singer-songwriter the Weeknd, from his fourth studio album, After Hours (2020). The song was released through XO and Republic Records on November 29, 2019, as the album's second single.

mood.title: Levitating
mood.about: "Levitating" is a song by English singer Dua Lipa from her second studio album, Future Nostalgia (2020). The song was written by Lipa, Clarence Coffee Jr., Sarah Hudson, and Koz, who produced the song with Stuart Price, and stemmed from a Roland VP-330 synthesiser sample played by Koz.

mood.title: Can't Stop the Feeling!
mood.about: "Can't Stop the Feeling!" is a song by American singer Justin Timberlake. It was released on May 6, 2016, as the lead single of the soundtrack to the film Trolls (2016), in which Timberlake voiced the character "Branch" and served as the executive music producer.

mood.title: Good as Hell
mood.about: "Good as Hell" is a song recorded by American rapper and singer Lizzo. mood.title: Walking on Sunshine
mood.about: "Walking on Sunshine" is a song written by Kimberley Rew for the English rock band Katrina and the Waves' 1983 album Walking on Sunshine. A rerecorded version was included on the band's 1985 album Katrina and the Waves and was released as its second single in April 1985.

mood.title: I Gotta Feeling
mood.about: "I Gotta [sic] Feeling" is a song by American group the Black Eyed Peas from their fifth studio album The E.N.D. (2009).

mood.title: Don't Start Now
mood.about: "Don't Start Now" is a song by English singer Dua Lipa. Lipa wrote the song with Caroline Ailin, Emily Warren, and its producer Ian Kirkpatrick.

mood.title: As It Was
mood.about: "As It Was" is a song by English singer-songwriter Harry Styles, released through Erskine and Columbia on 1 April 2022 as the lead single from his third studio album, Harry's House (2022). The song was written by Styles alongside his producers Kid Harpoon and Tyler Johnson.

mood.title: Anti-Hero
mood.about: "Anti-Hero" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift and the lead single from her tenth studio album, Midnights (2022). It was released on October 21, 2022, through Republic Records.

mood.title: Watermelon Sugar
mood.about: "Watermelon Sugar" is a song by English singer-songwriter Harry Styles from his second studio album, Fine Line (2019), included as the album's second track. Styles wrote the song with Mitch Rowland and the song's producers, Tyler Johnson and Kid Harpoon.

mood.title: Birds of a Feather
mood.about: "Birds of a Feather" is a song by American singer-songwriter Billie Eilish from her third studio album, Hit Me Hard and Soft (2024). It was released with the album on May 17, 2024, and was made the second official single on June 18, 2024, through Darkroom and Interscope Records.

mood.title: Party in the U.S.A.
mood.about: "Party in the U.S.A." is a song by American singer Miley Cyrus from her first extended play (EP), The Time of Our Lives (2009). It was released on August 4, 2009, by Hollywood Records as the lead single from the project.

mood.title: Roar
mood.about: "Roar" is a song by American singer-songwriter Katy Perry. It was released on August 10, 2013, by Capitol Records as the lead single from her fourth studio album, Prism (2013).

mood.title: Stay
mood.about: "Stay" is a song by Australian rapper and singer the Kid Laroi and Canadian singer Justin Bieber. It was released through Grade A Productions and Columbia Records on 9 July 2021, as the lead single from Laroi's reloaded mixtape, F*ck Love 3: Over You.

mood.title: Heat Waves
mood.about: "Heat Waves" is a song by British indie rock band Glass Animals released as a single from their third studio album Dreamland on 29 June 2020.

mood.title: Sunflower
mood.about: "Sunflower" is a song by American musicians Post Malone and Swae Lee. It was released on October 18, 2018, as a single from the soundtrack to the 2018 animated film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, and was later included on Post Malone's third studio album Hollywood's Bleeding (2019).

mood.title: Die With a Smile
mood.about: "Die with a Smile" is a song by American singer-songwriters Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars. It was released as a standalone single on August 16, 2024, through Interscope Records.

mood.title: Please Please Please
mood.about: "Please Please Please" is a song by American singer Sabrina Carpenter from her sixth studio album, Short n' Sweet (2024). It was released through Island Records on June 6, 2024, as the second single from the album.

mood.title: good 4 u
mood.about: "Good 4 U" is a song by American singer-songwriter Olivia Rodrigo. It was released on May 14, 2021, through Geffen and Interscope Records, as the third single from Rodrigo's debut studio album, Sour (2021).

mood.title: Just the Way You Are

mood.title: Treasure
mood.about: "Treasure" is a song by American singer and songwriter Bruno Mars from his second studio album, Unorthodox Jukebox (2012). It was written by Mars, Philip Lawrence, Ari Levine, and Phredley Brown, while production was handled by Mars, Lawrence and Levine under the name of the Smeezingtons.

mood.title: 24K Magic
mood.about: "24K Magic" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Bruno Mars from his third album 24K Magic (2016). Atlantic Records released it as the album's lead single on October 7, 2016, for digital download and streaming.

mood.title: Break My Soul
mood.about: "Break My Soul" is a song by American singer Beyoncé. It was released on June 20, 2022, through Parkwood Entertainment and Columbia Records as the lead single from her seventh studio album, Renaissance (2022).

mood.title: Cuff It
mood.about: "Cuff It" is a song by American singer Beyoncé from her seventh studio album, Renaissance (2022). It was released as the album's second single on September 30, 2022, through Parkwood Entertainment and Columbia Records.

flash.about: "The Sign" is a song by Swedish group Ace of Base from their first North American studio album, The Sign (1993), and their re-released debut studio album, Happy Nation (1992), titled Happy Nation . flash.about: "Just Dance" is the debut single by the American singer Lady Gaga. It was released on April 8, 2008, as the lead single from Gaga's debut studio album, The Fame (2008), through Streamline Records, KonLive, Cherrytree Records, and Interscope Records.

flash.title: TiK ToK
flash.about: "Tik Tok" is the debut solo single by American singer Kesha, who co-wrote the song with its producers Dr. Luke and Benny Blanco.

flash.title: California Gurls
flash.about: "California Gurls" is a song by American singer Katy Perry from her third studio album, Teenage Dream (2010). It was released as the album's lead single on May 7, 2010, through Capitol Records.

flash.title: Time After Time
flash.about: "Time After Time" is a song by the American pop singer Cyndi Lauper from her debut album, She's So Unusual (1983). It was released as the album's second single in March 1984, by Epic and Portrait Records.

flash.title: Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go
flash.about: "Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go" is a song by British pop duo Wham!, first released as a single in the UK on 14 May 1984. It became their first UK and US number one hit.

flash.title: Billie Jean
flash.about: "Billie Jean" is a song by the American singer Michael Jackson, released by Epic Records on January 2, 1983, as the second single from Jackson's sixth studio album, Thriller (1982). It was written by Jackson and produced by Jackson and Quincy Jones.

flash.title: Livin' la Vida Loca
flash.about: "Livin' la Vida Loca" is a song recorded by Puerto Rican singer Ricky Martin for his fifth studio album and English-language debut, Ricky Martin (1999). The song was written by Draco Rosa and Desmond Child, while the production was handled by the latter.

flash.title: Smooth
flash.about: "Smooth" is a song performed by American rock band Santana and Rob Thomas of Matchbox Twenty, who sings the lead vocals. It was released to radio on June 15, 1999, as the lead single from Santana's 1999 studio album, Supernatural, and was physically released as a single in August.

flash.title: Hanging by a Moment

flash.title: Waterfalls

flash.title: Vogue
flash.about: "Vogue" is a song by American singer Madonna from her soundtrack album I'm Breathless (1990). Written and produced by herself and Shep Pettibone, it was inspired by voguing, a dance popularized in New York City in the late 1980s.

flash.title: Into the Groove

Written by Madonna and Stephen Bray, it was originally intended for singer Cheyne before Madonna offered the recording to the film's director, Susan Seidelman, for a nightclub scene.

flash.title: All Star
flash.about: "All Star" is a song by the American rock band Smash Mouth from their second studio album, Astro Lounge (1999). Written by Smash Mouth guitarist Greg Camp and produced by Eric Valentine, the song was released on May 4, 1999, as the first single from Astro Lounge.
